items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: We had such stars in that show like Freddie Washington and Abbie Mitchell. And there was Eddie Rec-tor, and there was Johnny Hudgins.

ctx.x: Let's get to now the Club Alabam. When the -- did anything happen there or can we go to where the impresario walked in and heard you. Is there anything before that?

Yeah, before that. Because we built up a -- that Fall, like Lyons said, we went in there in May or June, or something like that. That Fall, Arthur Lyons put the show in. This was a great show. We had such stars in that show like Freddie Washington and Abbie Mitchell. And there was Eddie Rec-tor, and there was Johnny Hudgins. All these were stars in those days, you see. And we had this big show. This was the show that eventually I was to go to Europe with, you see.

And, now, I learned a lot of things, because I really learned how to really conduct a show, see. So we had a string of beautiful girls. It was the same type of show that later on played the Cotton Club. Well, the Cotton Club was only the echo from the Club Alabam.
